[[Siska's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Siska Scalewand]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Archipelagos]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Inspiration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Elliptical Staff]] [[dye]]d green.

==Replica==
It is possible to create a technical replica (excluding visual appearance) for this item with a:
*[[Hypnotic Staff]] from [[Kristo Trilios]].
*[[Perfect]] [[Insightful]] [[Staff Head]].
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]].

==Unique counterparts==
[[Handsmasher]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Domination Magic]].
